notes: This contract pins one bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 Dimension-table cross-field rule: the Input data type `NA` marker represents the branch in which no suitable named data type exists, so it cannot coexist with a named Input data type in one dimension. The official DIF/FDD mapping represents that table column as an inputDataTypes sequence, and this preflight keeps the explicit marker mutually exclusive with supplied non-NA names after complete-model composition. It deliberately does not decide whether a suitable named type exists, require a minimum number of names, deduplicate names, or judge the unambiguity of the companion description. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
